mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_episode_audio_job WHERE job_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.step FROM afv_media_job_submission s JOIN afv_episode_audio_job a ON a.job_id = s.job_id JOIN afv_media_job j ON j.id = a.job_id WHERE s.job_id = #{id} AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS(a.resolved_steps_json, JSON_QUOTE(s.step)) AND ((s.step = 'music' AND a.music_result_json IS NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(j.checkpoint_json, '$.music') IS NULL) OR (s.step = 'sfx' AND a.sfx_result_json IS NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(j.checkpoint_json, '$.sfx') IS NULL)) ORDER BY s.created_at, s.step

SELECT job_id FROM afv_episode_audio_job WHERE job_id = #{id} AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(music_result_json, '$.status')) = 'succeeded' OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sfx_result_json, '$.status')) = 'succeeded')
